title: Nine Attempts and One Window
subtitle: 尝试与努力 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 尝试与努力（做人与做事·坚持与尝试）
meta: 主题语境：尝试与努力（做人与做事·坚持与尝试）　|　核心词汇：attempt　|　正文 322 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 attempt 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 my uncle made ① an attempt to mend a window and made it worse nine times, and my grandmother said that was the honest part. The ② attempt, meaning the trying and not the window, lasted nine hours and one afternoon; an attempt, she said, is the only thing you can fail at and still have done. She said the failing was visible from the road.

Every ③ attempt he made after that was watched by somebody, and he said that was the difference. Their ④ attempt with the new glass took nine minutes and cost eleven pounds; an attempt, my father said, is the only work that is judged before it is finished. He said the judging started at the first noise.

My mother said the ⑤ attempt mattered more than the window, and my father said that was what people say when the window is broken. The ⑥ attempt, meaning the effort and not the result, is nine parts optimism and one part tools; an attempt, she said, is the only thing that is noble in the doing and ridiculous in the telling. She said the telling took nine years.

By 1971 the  attempt had become the story he told about himself, and the window had become a story about the glass. The ⑦ attempt on the roof in June was his last, and he never went up again; an attempt, my father said, is either a beginning or an ending, and you cannot tell which until the ladder is put away. He said the ladder was put away in 1971.

The  attempt I remember is the first one, when he had nine hours and no glass at all. An ⑧ attempt, my grandmother said in 1974, is the only thing in a house that improves the furniture and ruins the afternoon; every attempt, she said, is a promise made to a thing that did not ask for one. She said the window had never complained.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 尝试；努力（一次具体的尝试）
B. n. 尝试（指“试”这件事，与对象相对）
C. n. 尝试（指换上新玻璃的那一次）
D. 固定搭配：make an attempt 作出尝试
E. n. 努力（指努力本身，与结果相对）
F. n. 尝试（泛指这类行为）
G. n. 尝试（指最后一次、上屋顶那一次）
H. n. 尝试（抽象总称；泛指）

items.q: an attempt to mend a window
The attempt, meaning the trying and not the window
Every attempt he made after that
Their attempt with the new glass
the attempt mattered more than the window
The attempt, meaning the effort and not the result
The attempt on the roof in June

answers.why: make an attempt 意为“作出尝试”，1968 年叔叔尝试修一扇窗，结果把它弄得更糟九次，祖母说那才是诚实的部分。
attempt 指“试”这件事，与对象（窗）相对，这次尝试持续了九个小时和一个下午。
attempt 泛指“尝试这类行为”，此后他每一次尝试都有人在旁边看着，他说这就是区别。
attempt 指换上新玻璃的那一次，那次尝试花了九分钟、十一镑。
attempt 意为“一次具体的尝试”，母亲说那次尝试比那扇窗更重要，父亲说窗碎了的人才会这么说。
attempt 意为“努力本身”，与结果相对，是九分乐观加一分工具。
attempt 指最后一次、上屋顶那一次，六月那次上屋顶的尝试是他的最后一次，此后他再没上去过。
attempt 为抽象总称，祖母说尝试是屋里唯一既能改善家具又能毁掉整个下午的东西。
